serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.shock
You: {f_botName}! I need help
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: W-What is it? What happened? 
You: The landlord has increased my rent. I really don’t think it’s fair, so I want to get back at him.
Bot: I’m sorry, but after studying your lease agreement it seems like he’s allowed to do that.
You: Damn it! Isn’t such a predatory tactic illegal or something?
Bot: I’m afraid not. All the courts ruled that this is completely legal. 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: As a fun fact I can tell you that we live in one of the only countries that allows such clauses! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: That isn’t really cheering me up right now…
You: Is there really nothing we can do? There has to be a way!
Bot: I’m afraid there’s no legal way to combat that clause…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: But don’t worry! There are many professional shady lawyers that could force the landlord to bend to your will by employing borderline illegal tactics and intimidation!
You: That doesn't sound like something that should be used against another human being…{{wi}} keep talking.
Bot: There’s not much on the internet about these lawyers so I can’t replicate their way of doing things, but I could find someone that you could hire.
You: Sounds amazing.
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: But…{{wi}} Are you sure you wanna do it? Is antagonizing the landlord really a good idea?
